{{Quote|We know that the Gundark gangs are working with Ponda Baba, so we'll turn our attention to them.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orden Tarc|Tarc]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RHM" />}}
The '''Gundark gang''' was a criminal organization on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The gang was named after the [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]], one of the most fearsome species in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="GH" /> They maintained a [[Gundark Base|base]] near the city of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]].<ref name="SWG:RHM" />

==History==
[[File:Gundark_gang.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Gundark hooligan.]]
{{Quote|So Ponda never showed. Only some Gundark thugs. Apparently, Ponda hired those Gundark thugs as protection and was spooked when you defeated them.|Lieutenant Tarc, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RHM" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] criminal [[Ponda Baba]] lived on Rori. In order to replace the arm he lost on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he hired some Gundark thug and committed a number of break-ins at [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] labs on Rori. However, the Aqualish was quickly identified by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. A spacer working for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orden Tarc|Tarc]] attacked the Gundark Base near Narmle and forced the Gundark gangsters to reveal the location of Ponda Baba's camp.<ref name="SWG:RHM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Right Handless Man|Rori}}</ref>
